title: Spicy Korean Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew made with Korean chili flakes and tender tomatoes.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of zesty dressing in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 2 cups of stew and cook until the stew is heated through.
Add 2 teaspoons of Korean chili flakes and stir to combine.
Add 1 can (14 oz) of diced tomatoes and stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of aerated water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles if desired.
